title: SRO Scope Decision
description: Output of the deterministic scope engine. Produced by code, never by a model. There is no 'maybe in scope' verdict: UNKNOWN is blocked exactly like OUT_OF_SCOPE and additionally requires researcher clarification.

target.description: The string the agent asked about, verbatim.

status.description: IN_SCOPE is permitted subject to restrictions. OUT_OF_SCOPE and UNKNOWN both block execution.

matched_rule.description: The manifest rule that produced the verdict.

match_kind.description: 'exact' means the rule named the target itself; 'broad' means a rule covers it.

conflict.description: True when an inclusion and an exclusion both match. The exclusion is applied, and the manifest is self-contradictory and should be corrected by the researcher.

allowed.description: Derived: true only when status is IN_SCOPE.
